Sensory_Narial_Barbels.description: Slender and highly sensitive tentacles dangle from the creature's snout, each one capable of detecting the slightest vibrations in the muddied earth, granting it a keen tremorsense ability that enhances its perception in the murky, subterranean realms it calls home.

Prehensile_Labial_Palps.description: Emerging from the shadows of the swamp, the amphibian's prehensile labial palps are a mesmerizing blend of grace and menace, their tentacle-like mouthparts capable of grasping and manipulating objects with eerie precision, enhancing their agility and extending their reach in the murky depths.

Glandular_Toxic_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the shadowy recesses of the swamp, the Glandular Toxic Tendrils are long, serpentine appendages that pulse with a sickly green glow, dripping with a noxious venom capable of poisoning even the most resilient of adventurers, while their presence diminishes the charm of those around them and enhances their resilience in the face of such malevolent threats.

Aquatic_Filter_Cirri.description: The Aquatic_Filter_Cirri is a cluster of delicate, translucent tentacles that pulse rhythmically, serving as a vital filter for the amphibious creature, sifting nutrients from water with uncanny efficiency and bestowing upon it a subtle enhancement to its constitution.

Electroreceptive_Snout_Papillae.description: Emerging from the murky depths, the Electroreceptive Snout Papillae is a highly adapted sensory organ, covered in fine, gelatinous tentacles that ripple with an ethereal blue light, allowing the amphibian to detect electrical fields and navigate the dark, treacherous waters with uncanny precision and speed.

Elongated_Caudal_Lure_Appendage.description: This serpentine, tail-like appendage pulses with an otherworldly glow, its writhing tendrils adorned with bioluminescent nodes that serve as a hypnotic lure, enhancing the amphibian's charm and charisma to seduce both prey and unwitting adventurers.

Vascular_Respiratory_Filaments.description: The Vascular Respiratory Filaments are a network of delicate, translucent tentacles that emerge from the creature's throat and branch out beneath its skin, intertwining with its vascular system to facilitate both terrestrial and aquatic respiration, granting it an eerie grace and resilience in water.

Subterranean_Anchoring_Roots.description: Embedded deep within the flesh of this amphibious creature are thick, sinuous roots that serve both as anchors, firmly securing it to the ground, and as burrowing appendages, allowing it to dig with incredible force and speed, though at the cost of some agility.

Aposematic_Display_Fronds.description: Bristling with vibrant, pulsating tentacles that undulate in mesmerizing patterns, the aposematic display fronds serve as a terrifying yet hypnotic warning to predators, enhancing the creature's charisma and its ability to intimidate while simultaneously making it more conspicuous and harder to sneak past unnoticed.

Parasitic_Attachment_Suckers.description: Sinuous and slick, the parasitic suckers sprout from the creature's amphibian form, enabling it to cling to surfaces with prehensile tentacles that enhance its dexterity and reach, while granting it the sinister ability to grapple and drain life from its victims.
